macro_cross_check.verdict: PASS on the protein instrument (+7.4%), validating the 1.5 lb steak weight and every portion. CALLED OUT: the +22.3% calorie gap is a MARINADE-BASIS difference, not a portion error - the source pours half the marinade over the steak, then removes the steak and PATS IT DRY (step 6), discarding most of that half; their calculator plainly did not book it. We book the full marinade (all of it is poured over food; absorption is unknowable and estimating a discard fraction would be inventing data), so our figure is the ceiling-safe upper bound. Even fully booked the recipe sits mid-band; on the source's discard basis it would sit near 412 - both in [400, 650].
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 503.8 cal in [400, 650] PASS; carbs 18.8 g <= 35 PASS (honey and balsamic booked in full)
